name: NYC Parks Drinking Fountains
description:
This dataset is an inventory of drinking fountains in New York City parks, with 3,849 records and 12 fields. Each row describes one fountain, including its system identifier, fountain type, position (such as in a playground, in shade, under a tree, or indoors), whether it is painted, and its feature status, which is listed as active for every record. The data also identifies the park property by name and GIS property number, the parent park or building, the borough (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, or Staten Island), the fountain count at the location, the responsible parks department unit, and a short description combining type and park name. Most fountains are single installations, though some locations have two or three.

The dataset can be used to build public maps and directories that help park visitors locate drinking fountains, and to compare fountain availability across boroughs and parks. Because it records paint status, fountain type, and location details, it also supports maintenance

Semantic summary (topic and possible uses):
This dataset lists drinking fountains located in New York City parks, recording for each fountain its park property, borough, fountain type, position, paint status, and condition or feature status, along with identifiers linking it to its parent park. It belongs to the parks and recreation domain, specifically public amenities and asset management. The data could support maps and directories helping visitors find working fountains, maintenance planning and prioritization of repairs or repainting, and analysis of fountain availability and condition across boroughs and parks.
